headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Palantine Berm and Weathered Expanse Fronts
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, combat across the Palantine Berm has escalated dramatically, recording ten fresh strategic-base transitions over the past two hours as bitter fighting raged around Vendett and the Pippeli Stones. Concurrently, the Weathered Expanse witnessed a fierce resurgence in frontline clashes, suffering thousands of fresh casualties alongside three recent base turnovers that left key positions leveled in no-man's-land. Marban Hollow remained heavily contested with renewed activity at Checkpoint Bua, while the Nevish Line flared with fresh captures around Grief Mother and Blinding Stones amidst steep attritional losses. In the Linn of Mercy, base ownership stabilized over the past two hours despite unrelenting bloodshed, with over seventeen hundred combined casualties logged during the interval. Sector commands in Gutter, Mooring County, and the Stlican Shelf report quieter frontlines following earlier seizures, while rear logistics hexes across the far north and south remain completely undisturbed.
